measurement.shape: 9000 seeds, 33.6 MB jsonl (hosted-shaped, 36 MB class), local disk with fsync, 20 saves

after.note: cold process pays one sequential read (no write) to build the keyed index; a persisting save is then one keyed lookup and one pwrite+fsync. Hosted 1.2-1.5s/job was measured by the task owner; local numbers are not a hosted claim.

acceptance.1_bounded_write: JsonlRegistryStore.upsert_and_delete: keyed in-memory span index; new record = one pwrite at EOF; shrinking/equal update = in-place padded pwrite; growing an existing record = ordered rewrite (rare review path; keeps record order for all readers). Test: test_upsert_bytes_written_independent_of_store_size.
acceptance.2_replay: save() returns False and writes nothing on identical record (ignores materialization_mode); materializer skips save when rebuilt seed equals existing. Tests: test_identical_replay_writes_nothing, test_identical_replay_save_writes_nothing.

readers: StrategySpecSeedStore.get/list_all/list_by_status/list_by_bundle/get_by_bundle_idempotent/list_negative_memory_records/count (used by alpha-replication card admission, source-ingest runtime, BFF seed + persona-discovery reads)
3_readers.comparison: test_readers_match_legacy_full_scan compares indexed readers with a raw full file scan on the same data; 143 pre-existing seed/replication/distillation tests pass unchanged.

acceptance.4_temp_cleanup: Stale .<store>.*.tmp files removed on every mutation lease while holding the flock; overwrite_all still writes temp+replace, a kill leaves only a temp that the next write removes. Torn tail record is truncated by next write. Tests: test_stale_temp_files_removed_on_next_write, test_torn_tail_is_repaired_by_next_write.

5_growth_bound.at_cap: the lowest-priority active seeds are deleted in the same write as the new seed: draft/needs_more_evidence first, then other non-governed, then accepted/promoted, rejected/negative-memory last; oldest created_at first within a tier.
5_growth_bound.daily_growth: bounded by min(total cap 10000, sources x 50); steady-state file size is capped near the cap rather than growing daily.
5_growth_bound.idempotency: pruned seeds are remembered by bundle and seed id (bounded 20000 entries, in-process); replaying a pruned bundle returns the pruned seed instead of re-creating it. Limitation: this memory is per-process and lost on restart, so a replay after restart of a pruned bundle may re-create it once.
5_growth_bound.decision: same-bundle versions are not auto-pruned because distinct seed ids under one bundle are legitimate (merge/review flows rely on them); only caps prune.

acceptance.6_rollback: File format unchanged: one JSON object per line. Updated/deleted records leave blank (space-padded) lines which the previous release's reader skips (it ignores empty stripped lines). Test: test_update_and_delete_keep_legacy_reader_compatible. No downgrade step needed.
acceptance.7_tests: test_strategy_seed_store.py (27), test_jsonl_registry_store.py (5), replication_bridge/distillation_controller/l12_dist_001/hypothesis_extraction pass (143 total in the earlier run).
